decisions.reason: Selecting Mailreach and requiring its license for domain warm-up does not change the already registered domain, registrar, or domain-creation requirement.
The warm-up tool decision does not change the mailbox requirement or its required Gmail compatibility.
Domain warm-up through Mailreach does not alter the domain's web-forwarding destination or behavior.
The Mailreach license decision is independent of MeetAlfred configuration and its subscription plan.
The domain warm-up tool does not change Zapier configuration, subscription tier, or add-on requirements.
Domain warm-up may be preparatory to email outreach, but selecting Mailreach does not necessarily change the deferred automated email campaign's channel, platform, automation mode, or lifecycle.
The Mailreach warm-up decision does not change the deferred silent-lead follow-up workflow or its cleanup constraints.
Warming an email domain through Mailreach does not affect the independently defined automated LinkedIn campaign.
The warm-up tool and license do not alter the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method.
The domain warm-up decision does not change the requirement to preserve existing MeetAlfred integrations and campaigns.
Requiring Mailreach for domain warm-up does not modify the restrictions governing production leads and test identities.
The warm-up tool selection does not change whether email or LinkedIn communication history must be visible in HubSpot.
